'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Steve Baroni DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Steve Baroni]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
